LanguageData.RatkinQL_TollTree_Report: A ratkin claiming to be a toll collector blocked our path and demanded payment.
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Toll_Greeting: A ratkin plants himself at your gate, chest puffed. “Hold it right there, {Interviewer_labelShort}. This road don’t come free. Gotta pay the toll if you wanna keep using it.”
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Toll_OptWhy: “What gives you the right to charge me?”
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Toll_OptSeeThrough: “I can see right through you. Get lost.” (Requires Intellectual 8+)
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Toll_Why1: “I’m a duly appointed road-tax collector for the Kingdom of Rakinia. Signed, sealed, and everything. You want to see the paperwork?” He pats an empty pocket.
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Toll_Why2: “Me and my kin maintain this stretch. Fill potholes, chase off vermin—the works. You think that’s free? Cough up or find another road.”
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Toll_Why3: “It’s the Merchants’ Guild regulation, pal. Every settlement using this route has to pay a usage fee. Don’t shoot the messenger—shoot the guild.” He shrugs.
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Toll_Farewell: He straightens his collar and grunts. “Fine. Your loss.” He turns and shuffles off, muttering about ungrateful folk.
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Toll_MsgPay: He snatches the silver with both hands, grinning wide, then melts into the roadside weeds before you can change your mind.
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Toll_MsgSeeThrough: He freezes mid-bluster, ears drooping. “Ah... well. Y-You got me. Good eye.” He turns tail and scurries off without another word.
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Toll_MsgRefuse: He huffs, muttering something about “small-minded settlers,” then slinks away with a sour look.
LanguageData.RatkinQL_Toll_ReasonInt: Your negotiator's Intellectual skill is below 8.
